title: Immunization Services Protocol — Clocks for the Next Series Dose After a Dose Found Not to Count
content:
Pharmacy Clinical Services, Immunization Services protocol. This clause fixes the clock from which the earliest date for the next dose of a vaccination series is counted when a phone appointment for that dose is booked. Every clock counts in calendar days with the dose date it runs from as day 0.

## Clause 1 — the three clocks

1.1 **Repeat of a dose given too early.** Where the series history carries an invalidation entry for a dose given too early and the latest dose came after dose 1, the next dose repeats the invalid dose: it is given no earlier than the invalid dose's date plus the full minimum interval that separates the invalid dose from the dose before it, with no grace period, and a repeated dose 3 is also given no earlier than the date of dose 1 plus the dose 3 minimum interval from dose 1 less the grace period days.

1.2 **Dose given below the minimum age.** Where the series history carries an invalidation entry for a dose given below the minimum age, the clock runs from the latest dose's date with the minimum interval of that dose less the grace period days.

1.3 **Every other case.** The clock runs from the date of the latest dose on the series history with the minimum interval to the next dose less the grace period days; the minimum interval to the next dose is the dose 2 minimum interval after dose 1, and after dose 2 or a later dose it is the dose 3 minimum interval from dose 2, with dose 3 also no earlier than the date of dose 1 plus the dose 3 minimum interval from dose 1 less the grace period days.

## Clause 2 — terms fixed for this protocol

- **The latest dose** is the dose entry on the series history with the latest date; its dose number is the number that entry carries. Under 1.1 the invalid dose is that latest dose.
- **Dose 1** is the dose entry numbered 1 on the series history; where more than one is recorded, the latest-dated of them.
- **The latest dose came after dose 1** when the latest dose is dated on a later calendar day than dose 1. A latest dose dated the same day as dose 1 does not meet this condition.
- **The full minimum interval** under 1.1, and **the minimum interval of that dose** under 1.2, are both read from the number of the latest dose: the dose 2 minimum interval where the latest dose is dose 1 or dose 2, and the dose 3 minimum interval from dose 2 where it is dose 3 or later.
- Under 1.1 the grace period is not taken off the full interval; it is taken off only in the dose 1 limit for a repeated dose 3. Under 1.2 and 1.3 the grace period days are taken off every interval.
- Where the latest dose is dose 3 or later, 1.1 and 1.3 set two limits and the earliest date is the later of the two; 1.2 sets one limit only.

## Clause 3 — which clock governs

| Invalidation entry for a dose given too early on the history | Latest dose dated after dose 1 | Invalidation entry for a dose given below the minimum age on the history | Clock |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes or no | 1.1 |
| yes | no | yes | 1.2 |
| no | not relevant | yes | 1.2 |
| yes | no | no | 1.3 |
| no | not relevant | no | 1.3 |

The clauses are read in order: 1.1 governs whenever its two conditions hold, 1.2 governs when 1.1 does not and a below-minimum-age entry is on the history, and 1.3 governs otherwise.

## Clause 4 — interval figures by vaccination

| Vaccination | Dose 2 minimum interval (days) | Dose 3 minimum interval from dose 2 (days) | Dose 3 minimum interval from dose 1 (days) | Grace period (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | 56 | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | 28 | 56 | 112 | 4 |

## Clause 5 — illustrations on hypothetical dates

All dates below are hypothetical and are given as day counts, dose 1 of each series being day 0.

- *Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series, dose 2 given on day 20 and carrying an invalidation entry for a dose given too early.* The latest dose is dose 2 on day 20, dated after dose 1, so 1.1 governs: day 20 plus the full dose 2 minimum interval of 28 days, no grace period, gives day 48.
- *Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series, dose 3 given on day 90 after dose 2 on day 30, dose 3 carrying an invalidation entry for a dose given too early.* 1.1 governs with two limits: day 90 plus the full 56 days gives day 146; dose 1 plus 112 days less 4 grace days gives day 108. The later of the two, day 146, is the earliest date.
- *Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series, dose 1 on day 0 carrying an invalidation entry for a dose given below the minimum age, no other dose.* 1.2 governs: day 0 plus the dose 2 minimum interval of 56 days less 4 grace days gives day 52.
- *Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series, doses 1 and 2 on days 0 and 30, no invalidation entry.* 1.3 governs with two limits: day 30 plus 56 less 4 gives day 82; day 0 plus 112 less 4 gives day 108. The earliest date is day 108.
- *Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series, dose 1 on day 0, no invalidation entry.* 1.3 governs: day 0 plus 56 less 4 gives day 52.
